decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, it is considered that the proposed uses would not harm the retail function of the parade, would not harm neighbours' amenity and the proposed shop front would be compatible with the appearance of the parade and would provide disabled access in accordance in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), S.1.2 (Non retail uses in primary frontages), S.4.2 (Shop Front Design) and S.4.4 (Access to Shopping Facilities).

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The premises shall not be used other than for businesses providing services within use  classes A1 and A2 or as a beauty salon.
Condition : 4 - Informative 1: This planning permission does not constitute advertisement consent for the fascia sign shown on the submitted drawings.
description: Continued use of premises as 9 mixed commercial units (A1, A2 and beauty salon).
